Weekend speech snb

Speaker: Martin Schlegel

Economic outlook

Real GDP is projected to grow by 1.0% in 2026 and by 1.1% in 2027.

Inflation

Inflation is projected to average 1.8% in 2026.

Labour market

The unemployment rate is projected to average 4.0% in 2026.

Financial stability

Financial conditions remained tight and monetary policy transmission continued to function smoothly.

Monetary policy

The Swiss National Bank decided to maintain the policy rate.

Monetary policy will remain flexible and we will continue to act as necessary.

Risks

Risks to inflation were broadly balanced.
